name: Adratiklit
isnote: Described as a stegosaur close to dacentrurines (Maidment et al. 2020); the atlas has no Dacentrurinae clade.
sum: Adratiklit is a Middle Jurassic stegosaur from Morocco, one of the oldest known stegosaurs and the first from North Africa.
wsnote: Estimated body length of up to 7 m in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: NHMUK PV R37366, a dorsal vertebra — El Mers III Formation, near Boulemane, Morocco.
material: Referred cervical and dorsal vertebrae and a left humerus, bought from fossil traders.
biology: Known from a few bones; the sources give no direct evidence of behaviour.
author: Maidment et al. 2020
